name: Deploy View to Email Bison Campaign

nodes.name: Deploy Webhook
nodes.notes: The door's ONLY entry (ruling 2026-09-03). Schedule Live View Deploys creates the launch row and POSTs {recordId} here, so a scheduled deploy and a hand launch are the same run.

nodes.name: Prepare
nodes.notes: Mode prepare, awaited, error left to travel: resolves the launch row into client, base, campaign, mirror row, table, view and the field contract, drops DNC domains, applies the run cap and hands back the leads shaped for Email Bison. A failure inside it fails this run, which is the run the Error Logger names.

nodes.name: Get Bison Campaign
nodes.notes: DuoDiv's instance, hardcoded (ruling 2026-09-06). Credential: the Email Bison DuoDiv header auth (Authorization: Bearer <token>), attached in the UI.

nodes.name: Ready to Send?
nodes.notes: No leads to send is not a failure: a refused launch and a view where every row was skipped both go straight to the close, which stamps the rows and writes the row.

nodes.name: Route Call?
nodes.notes: Email Bison takes leads in two calls: create-or-update (returns ids), then attach-leads into the campaign. The item's kind says which call is next; both collectors feed Send Done?.

nodes.name: Bison Create Leads
nodes.notes: 200 leads to a request (Bison allows 500), existing_lead_behavior patch so a lead's other variables survive. Personal domains are dropped silently by the instance; Collect Create names them by comparing what came back with what was sent.

nodes.name: Bison Attach Leads
nodes.notes: allow_parallel_sending stays false: a lead already In Sequence in another campaign is refused by Bison, which is the instance's own dedupe.

nodes.name: Stamp Progress
nodes.notes: Writes live upload progress onto the launch row after every chunk. A SIDE branch of Collect Attach: it must never sit between Collect Attach and Send Done?, its Airtable output would destroy the loop state.

nodes.name: Any to Read?
nodes.notes: Nothing created this run = nothing to read back; straight to the close.

nodes.name: Bison Get Lead
nodes.notes: Read-back by id, one lead per call, paced: Bison lists are 15 to a page with no page-size control, so walking the campaign is never the proof.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Mode finish, awaited, error left to travel: stamps Deploy Error and the Campaigns links on the source rows, writes the Lead Lists receipt and writes this run's Hub row, upserted on this execution's id. A failed log write crashes it, and with it this run.
